title: Inertia is resistance to displacement through the temporal medium

statements.text: Continuity alone does not fix the coefficient of acceleration. When temporal and matter variables belong to one action, the fiber Hessian of that action is the inertial operator, so inertia is the positive curvature of the matter action against displacement through the temporal medium.

sources.quote: Continuity supplies the conserved current and temporal order, but it does not by itself fix the coefficient multiplying acceleration.
inertia is the positive curvature of the matter action against displacement through the temporal medium.
